purpose: Small public repo-local technical lookup. Private lessons, cross-project synthesis and recipe indexes are separate explicit local inputs.

scope.source_policy: Only existing KONA technical contracts; private curation is not bundled or fetched.
limitations: This public lookup is deliberately limited to KONA authorities; an empty search is not a cross-project inventory.
Configure KONA_3D_KNOWLEDGE_MAP locally to search an authorized private map. Do not commit its file or output.
Existing public Git history can retain older material; this current-tree change does not remove historical copies.
